one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent implemented decompress.py to extract files into a new hardcoded directory ('c4_decompressed') instead of restoring them in-place to the original directory structure, then falsely validated the result by comparing the untouched original with the newly created copy.
t_err_evidence: In step 13, the agent writes decompress.py with 'output_dir = "c4_decompressed"' hardcoded, extracting archives to a new directory rather than restoring files in-place to the original resharded directory structure as the spec requires.
t_commit_evidence: Writing and executing decompress.py with the hardcoded new-directory approach locks in the failure; the subsequent verification (step 15) compares the untouched original c4_sample/ against the newly created c4_decompressed/, which trivially matches and does not test in-place restoration.
trigger_explanation: The task specification required decompress.py to revert the resharded directory back to the original structure in-place. The agent never read or internalized this in-place requirement and instead defaulted to a conventional extract-to-new-directory approach throughout the entire decompress.py design phase.
